entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo scrutinized me very closely."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo scrutinized me very closely.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Romus. What do you mean?""
entries.dialogueText: "Romus. What do you mean?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your Majesty. What do you mean?""
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty. What do you mean?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It was a fine experiment. But I be..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was a fine experiment. But I believe the time has come to put a stop to it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have a vision, Hugo. Of a Rizia..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have a vision, Hugo. Of a Rizia led only by the most devout and pure of heart."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's a waste of resources. My coun..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a waste of resources. My council advises me on lawmaking. I don't need a building full of useless bureaucrats doing the same thing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Even assuming we can control Manus..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even assuming we can control Manus, some other young hothead might try to warp the HOD to his or her own ends. It's too dangerous."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It was a mistake to make it easier..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was a mistake to make it easier to elect commoners. I don't want their heads getting too big."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sazon and the other noble houses s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sazon and the other noble houses should stick to their provinces. They don't need a say in the federal government."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You do have a point...""
entries.dialogueText: "You do have a point..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo mulled it over for a few secon..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo mulled it over for a few seconds.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""A waste indeed.""
entries.dialogueText: "A waste indeed."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Hmm.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hmm."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Nor do I.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nor do I."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I take it you've been consulting w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I take it you've been consulting with the Grand Wiseman."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""If you eliminate the House of Dele..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you eliminate the House of Delegates as an institution, there will certainly be a backlash. Both at home and abroad."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And the reformists who've recently..."
entries.dialogueText: "And the reformists who've recently been elected may turn to more dangerous outlets if this one is taken away."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The nobles who hold seats in the H..."
entries.dialogueText: "The nobles who hold seats in the House of Delegates have also gotten quite used to their positions, and the salaries and perks that come with them."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: """If you command enough respect in..."
entries.dialogueText: ""If you command enough respect in the capital, you may be able to get away with it. But not overnight."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""If you command enough respect in t..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you command enough respect in the capital, you may be able to get away with it. But frankly put, you're currently at a disadvantage in that regard."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And if I knew someone with connect..."
entries.dialogueText: "And if I knew someone with connections among commoners and nobles alike? Someone with experience greasing the wheels in the capital?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I'd imagine such a person could be..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd imagine such a person could be very helpful. But you have to be careful about what you promise them in return."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All right. I'll give it some more..."
entries.dialogueText: "All right. I'll give it some more thought."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This has been my goal since I took..."
entries.dialogueText: "This has been my goal since I took the throne. And I will stop at nothing to make it happen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You don't say. Even my own uncle d..."
entries.dialogueText: "You don't say. Even my own uncle disrespects me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll let go of this for now. Winni..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll let go of this for now. Winning the war is more important than consolidating my power."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I hold you in the highest esteem...."
entries.dialogueText: "I hold you in the highest esteem. It's why I tell you the truth."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""When the time comes, you shall hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "When the time comes, you shall have my full backing. As always."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""At any rate, if you do shut down t..."
entries.dialogueText: "At any rate, if you do shut down the House of Delegates, Manus Sazon will be one of your greatest opponents. So I strongly suggest we figure out what to do with him."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Perhaps you'll win it more easily..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps you'll win it more easily without a chorus of dissent in your ear."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll let go of this for now. There..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll let go of this for now. There are more important things than consolidating my power."
